ei.title: 1번: Why a Bank Run Causes Bankruptcy
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: People sometimes worry that a bank will run out of money. So they all panic and try to withdraw their money. This is called a bank run. In some cases, it can cause a bank to go bankrupt. The reason for this is that most banks keep a limited amount of money in their safes. They do this for security purposes. The amount is only a small percentage of the total deposits made by customers. Therefore, if a bank run occurs, the bank must find a way to increase the amount of cash they have on hand. One way that they can do this is by selling their assets. These sales must be done quickly, so the price of the assets is likely to be much lower than normal. This can cause even more customer anxiety, leading to increased withdrawals.

questions.passage: People sometimes worry that a bank will run out of money. So they all panic and try to (A)[withdraw / deposit] their money. This is called a bank run. In some cases, it can cause a bank to go bankrupt. The reason for this is that most banks keep a (B)[limited / huge] amount of money in their safes. They do this for security purposes. The amount is only a small percentage of the total deposits made by customers. Therefore, if a bank run occurs, the bank must find a way to increase the amount of cash they have on hand. One way that they can do this is by selling their assets. These sales must be done quickly, so the price of the assets is likely to be much (C)[higher / lower] than normal. This can cause even more customer anxiety, leading to increased withdrawals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) withdraw=인출하다 / deposit=예금하다 (B) limited=제한된 / huge=막대한 (C) lower=더 낮은 / higher=더 높은
det.analysis:
① deposit—limited—lower: (A) 공황 상태에서는 돈을 인출(withdraw)하지 예금(deposit)하지 않음
② withdraw—limited—lower: 인출 + 제한된 금액 보관 + 정상보다 낮은 가격 ←정답
③ withdraw—huge—higher: (B)(C) 은행은 소액만 보관하고 급매 가격은 더 낮음
④ deposit—huge—lower: (A)(B) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 뱅크런 때 사람들은 돈을 withdraw(인출), 은행은 limited(제한된) 현금만 보유, 급매라 lower(더 낮은) 가격

questions.passage: People sometimes worry that a bank will run out of money. So they all (A)[panic / relax] and try to withdraw their money. This is called a bank run. In some cases, it can cause a bank to go bankrupt. The reason for this is that most banks keep a limited amount of money in their safes. They do this for security purposes. The amount is only a small percentage of the total deposits made by customers. Therefore, if a bank run occurs, the bank must find a way to (B)[increase / reduce] the amount of cash they have on hand. One way that they can do this is by selling their assets. These sales must be done quickly, so the price of the assets is likely to be much lower than normal. This can cause even more customer (C)[comfort / anxiety], leading to increased withdrawals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) panic=공황에 빠지다 / relax=안심하다 (B) increase=늘리다 / reduce=줄이다 (C) anxiety=불안 / comfort=안도감
det.analysis:
① relax—increase—anxiety: (A) 예금자들은 안심(relax)하는 게 아니라 공황(panic)에 빠짐
② panic—reduce—comfort: (B)(C) 은행은 현금을 늘려야 하고 결과는 불안 증가
③ panic—increase—anxiety: 공황 + 현금 확보(늘림) + 고객 불안 ←정답
④ relax—reduce—anxiety: (A)(B) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 사람들이 panic(공황) → 은행은 현금을 increase(늘림) → 고객 anxiety(불안) 증가의 흐름

questions.passage: People sometimes worry that a bank will run out of money. So they all panic and try to withdraw their money. This is called a bank run. In some cases, it can cause a bank to go bankrupt. The reason for this is that most banks keep a limited amount of money in their safes. They do this for (A)[security / danger] purposes. The amount is only a small percentage of the total deposits made by customers. Therefore, if a bank run occurs, the bank must find a way to increase the amount of cash they have on hand. One way that they can do this is by selling their assets. These sales must be done (B)[quickly / slowly], so the price of the assets is likely to be much lower than (C)[unusual / normal]. This can cause even more customer anxiety, leading to increased withdrawals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) security=보안 / danger=위험 (B) quickly=빠르게 / slowly=천천히 (C) normal=정상 / unusual=비정상
det.analysis:
① security—quickly—normal: 보안 목적 + 빠른 매각 + 정상보다 낮은 가격 ←정답
② danger—quickly—normal: (A) 은행은 danger가 아닌 security(보안) 목적으로 소액 보관
③ security—slowly—unusual: (B)(C) 매각은 빠르게 이뤄지고 기준은 normal(정상) 가격
④ danger—slowly—normal: (A)(B) 문맥과 반대
det.tip: 은행이 소액만 보관하는 건 security(보안), 급하니 quickly(빠르게) 팔아 normal(정상)보다 싸짐

questions.passage: People sometimes ①<u>worry</u> that a bank will run out of money. So they all panic and try to ②<u>deposit</u> their money. This is called a bank run. The amount is only a small percentage of the total deposits made by customers. Therefore, if a bank run occurs, the bank must find a way to increase the amount of cash they have on hand. One way that they can do this is by selling their ④<u>assets</u>. These sales must be done quickly, so the price of the assets is likely to be much lower than normal. This can cause even more customer anxiety, leading to increased withdrawals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① worry=걱정하다 ② withdraw→deposit (부적절) ③ security=보안 ④ assets=자산
det.analysis:
① worry: 은행에 돈이 바닥날까 걱정한다 — 적절
② deposit: 공황에 빠져 돈을 '예금하려' 한다? 인출(withdraw)이 원문 ←정답
③ security: 보안 목적으로 소액만 보관 — 적절
④ assets: 자산을 매각한다 — 적절
det.tip: 공황 상태에서는 돈을 withdraw(인출)하려 함. deposit(예금)은 정반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① panic=공황에 빠지다 ② limited=제한된 ③ lower→higher (부적절) ④ anxiety=불안
det.analysis:
① panic: 모두 공황에 빠져 돈을 찾으려 함 — 적절
② limited: 은행은 제한된 금액만 금고에 보관 — 적절
③ higher: 급매라 가격이 정상보다 '더 높다'? 더 낮은(lower)이 원문 ←정답
④ anxiety: 이는 고객의 불안을 키운다 — 적절
det.tip: 급하게 파는 자산은 정상보다 lower(더 낮은) 가격. higher는 정반대

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① bankrupt=파산한 ② percentage=비율 ③ selling→buying (부적절) ④ quickly=빠르게
det.analysis:
① bankrupt: 뱅크런은 은행을 파산하게 만들 수 있다 — 적절
② percentage: 보관액은 전체 예금의 작은 비율일 뿐 — 적절
③ buying: 현금을 마련하려 자산을 '사는' 방법? 파는(selling)이 원문 ←정답
④ quickly: 매각은 빠르게 이뤄져야 한다 — 적절
det.tip: 현금을 늘리려면 자산을 selling(매각)해야 함. buying(구입)은 정반대

questions.passage: This can cause even more customer anxiety, __________ (lead) to increased withdrawals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: lead(동사: 이끌다) → leading(분사구문: ~을 초래하며). 앞 절의 결과를 나타내는 분사구문
det.analysis: lead를 현재분사 leading으로 변환. 'This can cause ~ anxiety, leading to ~' = '~을 초래하여 ~로 이어진다' — 앞 절의 결과를 나타내는 분사구문에서 현재분사 필요
det.tip: 콤마 뒤 결과를 나타내는 분사구문 → 현재분사(-ing) → leading

questions.passage: These sales must be done quickly, so the price of the assets is __________ (like) to be much lower than normal.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: like(동사/전치사) → likely(형용사: ~할 것 같은). be likely to로 '~할 가능성이 높다'
det.analysis: like를 형용사 likely로 변환. 'the price is likely to be lower' = '가격이 더 낮아질 가능성이 높다' — be동사 뒤 보어 자리 + to부정사와 함께 쓰는 형용사 likely 필요
det.tip: be _____ to ~ 구조 + '~할 것 같다' 의미 → 형용사 likely

questions.passage: People sometimes worry that a bank will __________ money. So they all panic and try to withdraw their money. This is called a bank run. In some cases, it can cause a bank to go bankrupt. The reason for this is that most banks keep a limited amount of money in their safes. They do this for security purposes. The amount is only a small percentage of the total deposits made by customers. Therefore, if a bank run occurs, the bank must find a way to increase the amount of cash they have on hand. One way that they can do this is by selling their assets. These sales must be done quickly, so the price of the assets is likely to be much lower than normal. This can cause even more customer anxiety, leading to increased withdrawals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: take care of=~을 돌보다 / run out of=~을 다 써버리다 / hold on to=~을 붙잡다 / deal with=~을 다루다
det.analysis:
① take care of: 은행이 돈을 돌본다? 걱정의 대상과 안 맞음
② run out of: 은행에 돈이 바닥날까 걱정함 ←정답
③ hold on to: 돈을 붙잡는다? 사람들이 걱정하는 상황과 반대
④ deal with: 돈을 다룬다? 문맥 부적절
det.tip: worry that a bank will __________ money → 돈이 고갈되다(run out of)

questions.passage: People sometimes worry that a bank will run out of money. So they all panic and try to withdraw their money. This is called a bank run. In some cases, it can cause a bank to go bankrupt. The reason for this is that most banks keep a limited amount of money in their safes. They do this for security purposes. The amount is only a small percentage of the total deposits made by customers. Therefore, if a bank run occurs, the bank must find a way to increase the amount of cash they have __________. One way that they can do this is by selling their assets. These sales must be done quickly, so the price of the assets is likely to be much lower than normal. This can cause even more customer anxiety, leading to increased withdrawals.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: on hand=보유하고 있는 / in debt=빚진 / at risk=위험에 처한 / for sale=판매 중인
det.analysis:
① on hand: 손에 쥔(보유한) 현금의 양을 늘려야 함 ←정답
② in debt: 빚진 현금? 문맥 부적절
③ at risk: 위험에 처한 현금? have와 안 맞음
④ for sale: 판매 중인 현금? 문맥 부적절
det.tip: the amount of cash they have __________ → 보유하고 있는(on hand)
